The phrase 'preferred to wait' rests on a redacted token in the note ('CX ⟦NAME_1⟧ WAIT FOR APP'), so the analyst may want to confirm it, but it is a fair reading of the note and does not guess the token's content.

no_internal_disclosure.note: No mention of flags, compliance review, priority or automated systems.
